title: feat: prompt users to enable support for events
body:
**Summary**

This PR updates create-instantsearch-app with a new question asked during the interactive process, to get users consent on enabling events in InstantSearch templates.

This question is only added when the template has a library version that has the `insights` prop.

FX-2660
